cover.headline: "Comment GUIDE": the Instagram trick that turns comments into sales on autopilot. 7 prompts to build it:

person_photo.author: Anthony Quintano from Westminster, United States

design.mood: a phone lighting up with notifications in the dark: moody navy-black bokeh, a hot-pink alert badge, the quiet buzz of a DM that's about to become a sale
design.label: pill

slides.title: prompts to turn comments into sales with DM automation
slides.sub: The comment-to-DM funnel top creators use, written in your own words.
slides.voiceover: Here are seven prompts to turn Instagram comments into a real sales funnel.

slides.name: The Lead Magnet
slides.prompt: Act as a funnel strategist. My audience is [AUDIENCE] and I sell [PRODUCT]. Give me 5 free lead magnet ideas people would comment a keyword to get (checklist, template, mini-guide), how fast I can make each, and which one leads most **NATURALLY** to my product.

lines: Leads naturally to: your paid setup

slides.voiceover: One. Find a freebie worth commenting for in the first place.

slides.name: The Keyword Post
slides.sub: A post built to earn comments.
slides.prompt: Write an Instagram carousel outline that ends with 'Comment [KEYWORD] and I'll send you [FREEBIE]'. 7 slides: a hook, 5 value slides that make people want more, and the ask. Add a caption whose first line repeats the **KEYWORD** offer.
slides.tip: The value slides do the real work — a keyword ask with no value behind it just trains people to scroll past.
slides.voiceover: Two. Build the post that actually earns those comments.

slides.name: The DM Flow
slides.sub: An auto-reply that doesn't feel automatic.
slides.prompt: Write the automated DM sequence for people who comment [KEYWORD]: the first message with the freebie, a question to learn what they need, 2 reply branches based on their answer, and a soft offer for [PRODUCT]. Friendly, short, and **HUMAN**.

lines: Here's your guide! Quick q – solo or team?

slides.voiceover: Three. Script a DM sequence that reads like a person, not a robot.

slides.name: The Tool Setup
slides.prompt: Explain step by step how to set up comment-to-DM automation for Instagram with [TOOL], using only official, policy-compliant features. Include the trigger, the message steps, how to tag leads, and the **LIMITS** or rules I must respect.
slides.tip: Instagram only allows one automated private reply per comment, and it has to happen within 7 days — build the flow around that limit, not around what you wish it allowed.
slides.voiceover: Four. Get the setup steps, and the platform limits you have to respect.

slides.name: The Follow-Up Sequence
slides.sub: For people who took the freebie and went quiet.
slides.prompt: Write a 3-message follow-up for people who got my free [FREEBIE] but didn't buy [PRODUCT]: day 2 (a useful tip), day 4 (a short customer story), day 7 (a clear offer with a deadline). Each under 60 words, **NO GUILT-TRIPPING**.

lines: Day 2: one tip they can use today
Day 7: the offer, with a real deadline

slides.voiceover: Five. Follow up with people who went quiet, without sounding pushy.

slides.name: The Objection DMs
slides.prompt: People reply to my DMs about [PRODUCT] with: 'how much?', 'I'll think about it', 'is it worth it?', 'I don't have time'. Write a short, honest reply to each that answers the real worry and gives **ONE** next step.
slides.tip: One next step per reply — three options in a DM reads as pressure, one reads as help.
slides.voiceover: Six. Have a real answer ready for the objections you hear every week.

slides.name: The Funnel Review
slides.sub: Find the leak in your numbers.
slides.prompt: Here are my funnel numbers: [COMMENTS] comments, [DMS] DMs sent, [REPLIES] replies, [SALES] sales. Tell me where the biggest leak is, 3 likely reasons, and one test for each stage I can run **THIS WEEK**.

lines: Likely cause: first message too long
Test this week: cut it to 1 line

slides.voiceover: Seven. Find exactly where your funnel is leaking, and what to test first.

slides.title: Get more out of this pack
items: One clear keyword on one post beats three vague ones spread across your feed — easier to promote, easier to track.
Only use official automation features and respect the one-reply, 7-day window — that's what keeps the account safe.
Comments and DMs sent are vanity — replies and sales are the numbers that tell you where to fix the flow.
slides.voiceover: Start with one keyword, stay inside the rules, and review your numbers weekly.
